subject: Recap & next steps — pilot scope, success metrics, procurement timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearwave.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps — pilot scope, success metrics, procurement timeline

Hi Elena and team,

Thanks again for the call today — really productive. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please correct anything I got wrong.

Key pain points you mentioned:
- High latency from current vendor causing poor search/response times in customer support flow (targets: P95 < 250ms).
- Token costs ballooning on peak traffic days; need predictable per-ticket economics.
- Data residency requirement for EU accounts (not in scope for initial US pilot but will matter for expansion).

Pilot scope (what we propose):
- 6-week pilot focused on the customer support triage workflow (ingest recent support transcripts + live sandbox).
- Up to 100k tokens/day expected during peak; Redwood will provision a Dedicated pool for consistent perf.
- Success metrics: average latency P50/P95, answer relevance (NPS delta), and cost per ticket.

Milestones & dates (proposed):
1) SOW & pricing sign-off — target: 2026-06-22 (Tom/procurement review)
2) Network/security review & whitelist — target: 2026-06-25 (ClearWave security)
3) Pilot provisioning & data ingestion — target: 2026-06-29
4) Pilot run (4 weeks) — 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-29
5) Review & decision — 2026-08-05

Owners:
- Redwood commercial: Ben Carter (me) — overall owner / procurement coordination
- Redwood solutions: Soojin Lee — pilot config, telemetry, evals
- Redwood finance: Marcus Lin — pricing and billing cadence
- ClearWave: Elena Park — product lead; Tom Reyes — procurement contact; ClearWave Legal — contract review

Attachments included: SOW draft v1, pricing worksheet, network diagram. I also attached a short list of the telemetry we’ll expose in the console (latency by route, token breakout, per-request trace ids).

Immediate asks (please reply inline):
- Tom: can you confirm procurement timeline/DocuSign contact?
- Elena: ok with milestones/dates above? Any missing stakeholders?
- ClearWave security: can you confirm firewall/IP allowlist window?

If that looks good I’ll route a cleaned SOW + pricing to Tom and legal for signature.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Thanks Ben — this is great and matches my notes. A couple small clarifications: 

- The initial pilot should exclude PHI ingestion; we’ll scope sample anonymized transcripts for the pilot.
- Procurement: Tom, if possible we’ll aim to wrap pricing/PO by 6/22; legal will need ~5 business days after SOW is complete.
- Security: we’ll share the allowlist and expected test window by end of day Thursday.

One ask from product: can Redwood expose per-intent accuracy (we’ll share a 10-intent eval set)? That will be a primary success metric for our CS team.

If you can get the SOW to us by EOD 6/18 we should be able to hit the 6/22 sign-off target.

Thanks,

Hey all — quick technical notes from our solutions side so the pilot hits your evaluation criteria: 

- We’ll provision a Dedicated GPU pool in us-west-2 to minimize latency for your east-coast users (we can mirror to eu-west-1 for EU data later).
- Model variant: start with the rdx-13B-quant (lower cost, competitive quality); we’ll run a short A/B with a 13B fp16 if you want head-to-head.
- Telemetry: exposing per-intent accuracy is fine — please upload the eval set (CSV with canonical intents) to the secure upload link I’ll send.
- Data handling: Redwood’s platform will only store transient telemetry; we’ll honor the retention window you specify in the SOW.

I attached the network diagram showing endpoints and required ports. Happy to run a short tech sync with your infra team before the allowlist window.

— Soojin

Thanks Tom — I prepared a one-page pricing summary and the billing cadence. High level: 

- Pilot (6 weeks): reserved Dedicated capacity with burst to hosted up to 150k tokens/day cap. Estimated cost: $18,500 for the pilot (line items in attached pricing sheet).
- Post-pilot committed tier pricing options will be included as three bands (monthly commits) — I’ll include a short table in the SOW for easy PO attachment.
- Net30 for pilot billing is acceptable; Redwood Finance will issue invoices after the first week of the pilot (pro-rated) unless you prefer otherwise.

I attached the pricing worksheet and a render of the SOW payment terms. Happy to hop on a quick call with procurement tomorrow.
